nodes.title: A paired child device boots child mode from the readable tx_paired cookie and GET /api/child/boot, never /api/me (403 scope.child_device on a device-only browser). The boot's me is cut client-side to scope:'child', guardian:null, that one child. A 401 with tx_paired set means unpaired: back to /pair with a gentle note. Supersedes the /api/me scope:'child' ask in dc-r7-app-device-pairing. Reverse: Platform serves a child-scoped /api/me.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-device-boot`
The child's own device knows whose it is from a cookie the pairing left, and asks only child routes for the rest. Nothing on it shows a brother's or sister's name or the parent's email.
